answer: Proof of Agent networks thwart Sybil swarms using recursive cryptographic attestation chains and zero-knowledge proofs. To mint an identity, agents must stake capital that scales as O(k^2) against identity density within a cluster. When a malicious nebula of fake nodes attempts to flood the network, this superlinear bonding curve triggers exponential capital exhaustion. A rising tide of required collateral sweeps away cloned entities before they reach the verification horizon, ensuring attacks become mathematically unsustainable.
